description: This is a React component file named Dashboard.js that renders the dashboard page of a Kanban task management application. It uses hooks from React and a custom hook useKanban to fetch and display live data related to tasks, such as status counts, assignee summaries, and column summaries. The component primarily focuses on rendering a high-level overview, including KPI cards and three overview widgets (Status, Assignees, Columns).

methods.name: Dashboard()
methods.description: React functional component providing the main dashboard view, summarizing Kanban data visually with key metrics and widgets.
